package.limits: Full optimized suite and universal package on this host. Synthetic native canvas events/offscreen rendering are not live desktop or physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 tests. Xcode project unchanged; new files use existing synchronized groups.

api.parameters: font.inspect: installed PostScript font, start/count (1–512). text.glyph: layerID/font/glyphID, optional UTF-16 location/length. Type descriptions: orientation, style.fontOptions features/variations/language and glyphOverride. Omitted font option arrays default empty.
api.state: layers[].text and capabilities.text.fonts expose orientation/options, schemas, installed font inspection and limits. Shared desktop/API glyph insertion retains character/paragraph state.
api.guards: Existing authentication, share, revision, lock and interaction guards; read inspection also requires a settled editor. Invalid scalar splits/axes/options reject before mutation.

adobe_api.scope: Existing text_layer add/edit now accepts textOrientation horizontal/vertical and capsOption normal_caps/small_caps. Shared native engine and editable PSD job output.
adobe_api.limits: Arbitrary OpenType tags, variable axes, glyph IDs and language tags are native-only: the pinned published contract has no matching fields. Other pre-existing text adapter restrictions remain; no full Adobe/cloud/font-service compatibility claim.

limitations: Full Photoshop composers, missing-font substitution, language rules, anti-alias/kerning/pixel equality remain open. Fonts provide their own feature coverage; TimesNewRomanPSMT on this host did not substitute fi/ffi.
Vertical outline conversion rejects explicitly; path/warp/Dynamic Text are next major T04 scope.
Glyph enumeration maps BMP characters; unmapped glyphs retain explicit IDs using U+FFFC. Supplementary text remains normally typable.
Semantic Actions recording of arbitrary type edits, complete PSD text forms and FontCaps synthetic behavior remain unqualified.
Synthetic/offscreen AppKit and host tests only; no unlocked live UI, independent Photoshop save/reopen, IME/accessibility or physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 qualification.
next: T04: editable text on paths and warped/Dynamic Text; defer phase2 type utilities and exact/cosmetic refinements.
